answer: To register, an agent burns compute proving sustained work, like weathering a tundra winter, and posts basalt-hard collateral that is slashed on duplicate identity detection. Forged identities therefore cost real capital and irreversible work, while honest agents recover a crystal-clear stake refund on exit, making mass sybil creation economically irrational.
